checks.approved_wording: B02, B03, B04, and B08 have 10 m sampling. B05, B06, B07, B8A, B11, and B12 have 20 m sampling.
checks.qualification: Do not imply every visible or near-infrared band is 10 m. Smaller-pixel benefits are a project inference, not measured superiority.

checks.approved_wording: Landsat 8/9 multispectral sampling is 30 m. Thermal measurements are acquired at 100 m. Their orbits have an eight-day offset.
checks.qualification: The panchromatic band is 15 m. Nominal revisit does not guarantee cloud-free or usable imagery.

checks.approved_wording: Sentinel-2 offers more frequent nominal optical coverage than the Landsat 8/9 pair.
checks.qualification: Comparison of nominal five-day Sentinel-2 coverage and eight-day Landsat pair offset. Actual coverage depends on operations, latitude, overlap, and clouds.

checks.approved_wording: The Landsat archive reaches back to 1972.
checks.qualification: Removed an unsupported attribution to this FAQ about differing mission generations. No claim of uniform sensor capability across the archive.

checks.approved_wording: True color: B04/B03/B02. Infrared false color: B08/B04/B03. NDVI: (B08-B04)/(B08+B04). Green-NIR NDWI: (B03-B08)/(B03+B08).
checks.qualification: Apply reflectance calibration first. NDWI has other definitions. The presentation uses the green-NIR formulation.

checks.approved_wording: NDVI contrasts red and near-infrared response. Vegetation absorbs red light and reflects strongly in near-infrared.
checks.qualification: Spectral contrast is not a direct plant-health diagnosis or a validated water-quality concentration.

checks.approved_wording: Sentinel-2A launched in 2015, 2B in 2017, and 2C on 2024-09-05. Each satellite carries a single payload, the Multi-Spectral Instrument, with four bands at 10 m, six at 20 m, and three at 60 m.
checks.qualification: The page names one instrument for every satellite. It does not use the word same. Ground processing baselines still change and are tracked separately.

checks.approved_wording: Landsat sensors changed across missions: MSS on Landsat 1 to 5 at 60 m, TM on 4 and 5 at 30 m, ETM+ on 7 at 30 m, and OLI with TIRS on 8 and 9 at 30 m with 100 m thermal. Band designations differ between sensors.

checks.approved_wording: Cloud-mask expansion can mark clear pond pixels as cloudy within 80 m of qualifying clouds. Shoreline and other exclusion rules apply.
checks.qualification: Baseline 04.00 and later. Cloud probability above 65 percent, components larger than three pixels. Shoreline and soil/snow boundary exclusions apply. Urban dilation requires more than 1000 pixels at 20 m.

limitations: Documentation checks are not sensor validation or human approval.
The owner supplied the Sentinel-2-versus-Landsat emphasis on 2026-09-11 and the page carries it. Which bands carry which water-quality signal is project rationale, not a checked claim.
AWS and processing summaries use existing repository evidence. They were not newly surveyed for this presentation.
The educational map crop does not validate the fallback archive or select a production workflow.
